title: Users
intro: Local accounts in the configuration (management.users). Changes go into the candidate and take effect after a commit.
adminOnly: Signed in as {{role}}: only administrators can add, change or remove users.
deleteBody: The user is removed from the candidate. The account keeps working until the change is committed.
deleteSelf: This is your own account. After the commit you can no longer sign in with it.
passwordNote: Leave the password hash empty to keep the current password. Sign-in to the web UI and API needs an argon2id hash ($argon2id$…); this screen cannot compute one from a plain password yet.
bootstrapNote: The first administrator created at installation is not part of the configuration until it is added here; it is never removed by a commit.

empty.title: No users configured yet
empty.body: You are signed in as {{user}}, the account created at installation. When you add the first user, also add an administrator — for example your own account, whose password is kept.

username.title: Username
username.help: Lower-case letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter or _.

role.title: Role
role.help: Administrator: everything. Operator: edit and commit configuration, no users or AAA. Read-only: view only.

scope.title: Scope
scope.help: * = the whole device (tenant scopes come later).

passwordHash.title: Password hash
passwordHash.help: Write-only: never shown again. Empty = keep the current password.

sshKeys.title: SSH public keys
sshKeys.help: OpenSSH lines such as ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.help: Keep the account but refuse sign-ins.
